label: S3: Get Object
description: Read an object from an S3-compatible bucket into storage and emit its stored-file reference (streamed, so large objects are fine). The file is stored with the run and deleted with it (once the run's record goes); wire it through KeepFile to keep it past that.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The object store access (wire an S3Access node).

then.message: S3GetObject '{id}': `bucket` is empty, `.` or `..`, which no URL can address; name a real bucket.
S3GetObject '{id}': `key` has a `.` or `..` path segment, which URL normalization collapses into a different key; rename the object.
